svg.title: Software factory architecture: governed verification changes
svg.desc: Human authority governs delivery and factory improvement. Proposed changes to verification pass through protected reference evaluation and independent authorization before staged adoption. Shared observability retains verdicts and adoption history. Definitions, memory and execution infrastructure remain explicit.
svg.text: Deliver software. Automatically improve the factory that delivers it. Keep human authority explicit.
HUMAN PLANE / SET DIRECTION, AUTHOR DEFINITIONS, OBSERVE AND GOVERN
Author files; observe and govern changes.
Set permissions, budgets and escalation rights.
One evidence layer for human oversight and automatic factory improvement.
Traces · tool calls · cost · latency · retries
Package + artifact revisions · Policy + verifier versions · Evidence links · Verdict + authorized action
Durable history · Expiry / invalidation · Overrides · Outcomes · Links to source traces
VERIFICATION-CHANGE GATE / CHANGES TO THE CHECKER ARE WORK PACKAGES
Intent + contracts · Valid / invalid behaviors · Original failures · Coverage and risk deltas
Criteria changes require separately authorized acceptance. Different model ≠ independent authority or evidence.
authorized verifier version → active verification pressure

g.text: Turn demand into prioritized, scoped work.
AI review · Risk judges · Behavioral evals
Turn findings into the next iteration.
Crashes · Bugs · CVEs · Drift · Codebase health
Turn observed software health into corrective action.
Hold / halt · flag off · isolate. Restore
VERSIONED WORK PACKAGE / SHARED ACROSS DELIVERY
corrective work → reprioritize, rescope or repair
Versioned files used by the factory
Permissions, risk, escalation and release rules
Build or integrate; keep capabilities replaceable
Runs both delivery agents and verification systems
Shared telemetry, agent runs, findings, production
Find recurring failures in context, agents, tools,
Suggest or configure agents, tools and runtimes.
Changed checks go through the separate gate
Canary and compare outcomes. Contain failures;
restore only when safe. Record outcomes in
candidate verifier version → independent adoption gate
edit rules, skills and policies as files
configure / inspect agents, tools and runtimes
read / write memory · validate durable knowledge
Governed improvement: SWF changes are versioned, independently evaluated and reversible. Authority expands through explicit human decisions.
